remarks: Welcome to life at the TOP of Soundview Towers! The majestic views of the Stamford skyline and the dazzling sunsets from the balcony of the 16th floor penthouse are unparalleled. This oversized one bedroom condo has been tastefully and fully renovated and modernized. The open concept living room, kitchen, and dining room provide a lovely spacious feeling. The new kitchen with white cabinets, unique blue hued granite countertops, and complimentary backsplash adds a tasteful aura to the space. Culinary delights are prepared on all new stainless-steel appliances with gas range. There is a huge & bright master bedroom with a barn door walk-in closet and a beautiful view of the city. Unlike many condos, there is ample room for storage with five closets including two walk-in. The new floors throughout aesthetically bring the space together. The bathroom has also been totally updated; the imported tiling adds a touch of sophistication. Two new HVAC units assure proper cooling and heating throughout the year. This gem is a model home of convenience and affordability. Soundview towers is a premier doorman building within a short stroll of the fine restaurants of downtown Stamford and its energetic night life. For those commuters, I-95 and the Stamford train station are just minutes away. The monthly common charges include heat, cooking gas, water/hot water and trash. This sought-after complex has a pool, fitness center with sauna room, covered parking and ample visitor parking.
